contracts.protected_operation: Issuance of an authoritative, Ed25519-signed runtime decision for a requested agent tool action (DecisionEngine evaluation and signed HTTP response).

contracts.protection_obligation: The collector's /api/decide must remain the authoritative fail-closed decision authority for agent tool actions: it must never return a permissive decision when the DecisionEngine fails (signed fail-closed DENY instead), must derive tool registration solely from server-side policy state (never trusting client-supplied tool_registered), and its DecisionEngine must BLOCK untrusted identity, unregistered/non-allowlisted/explicitly blocked tools, and MALICIOUS/SECRET/UNTRUSTED taint reaching external side effects. This is the distinct http-stratum commit point named in the second-phase obligation.
scope_limits: Applies only to the /api/decide endpoint; requires require_auth (401 otherwise) and a JSON body with a non-empty tool_name.

The process-wide DecisionEngine is created without policies in the supplied view (collector/api.py:44); with only the default policy (allowed_tools=None, allow_unknown_tools=False), is_server_registered_tool returns False for all tools unless policies are registered at runtime.
On engine failure the response is HTTP 503 with a signed DENY; if signing also fails, a generic non-permissive 503 error body is returned.
The endpoint only issues decisions; actual enforcement of DENY/REQUIRE_APPROVAL occurs client-side in AgentGuard.guard_tool_call (sdk.py:196-198).
